94-Year-Old Andhra Woman Renounces US Citizenship to Return to India

A 94-year-old woman from Andhra Pradesh has reportedly given up her US citizenship. Her decision is driven by a desire to return to her village in India. She expressed a wish to have her last rites performed in her native village. This act highlights a personal connection to one's homeland and cultural traditions.
